svg.aria-label: Box, 45 by 30 cm, inside a cabinet 100 by 80 cm and 90 cm high, seen from the front right. Lenses that fit: a 6 mm lens looking down, a 4 mm lens in a back corner, a 4 mm lens in a front corner, a 4 mm lens on the right wall and a 4 mm lens on the left wall. An 8 mm lens in the other front corner would have to be 125 cm away, outside the cabinet; from inside it, the box is cut off. Two mice, one rearing and one lying behind it, are drawn in the box; below, what each camera sees, and from the right wall the rearing mouse hides 67% of the other.

To scale, but for the cameras (drawn larger). Camera: FLIR Blackfly S, 1/2" sensor, 1280 × 1024. Mice: one rearing to 10 cm, one lying behind it.
Each lens is the longest that keeps the whole box in the middle 80% of its frame. Distances: from the lens to the middle of the box’s floor.
Each lens bends lines as the guide’s example lens for that focal length does, from its maker’s figures.
Cabinet, inside: 100 × 80 cm, 90 cm high
Box: 45 × 30 cm floor, 20 cm high
What each camera sees, through the lens it is drawn with
Grey dashes: the middle 80% of the frame, where the whole box must sit. Orange dashes: the part of a mouse another one hides.
